items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: His son was named Little Buddy. ... He come to me. He's living right there on his side. I said, what you want for it? ... So, okay, take the horn.

ctx.x: Yeah, I got rid of it. I got another one. I bought another one. I bought his horn from his son. What kind was it? It was a coin. A CD coin I bought from his son. I paid his son. It was $27 for a horn. He had a little head horn. His son was named Little Buddy. See? Well, he is pushed up for money. You understand what I mean? Yeah. Well, his daddy gave him the horn. He's learning. He needed money. He had a wife. And he come to me. He's living right there on his side. He said, man, I want to sell a horn. I said,…
So you don't know where it is?
